svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Keep a usable rollback, not an expired shortcut
Application server (TLS-APP01) · RHEL 9 Bash terminal · learner@10.90.0.10
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
# Recovery only when the previous v1 pair is still valid and safe:
sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
A deliberately performed rollback restores the previous v1 serial; otherwise leave the
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. Read the command below. Use it only if activation failed and the earlier v1 certificate is still
valid and its key is safe.
2. After copying the known-good config, test it before reload. Then repeat the same client TLS check.
3. If the old certificate is expired or the old key is compromised, do not restore it for users. Keep
the service protected and issue a valid replacement through your approved incident/change process.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
